findings.summary: coverageCommand and coverageArgs in scripts/pre-push-patch-coverage.mjs run `vitest related --run --coverage ...` without --passWithNoTests. A change to a non-test-imported file inside a touched package (bin script, .d.ts, YAML/JSON asset, new source without test) makes related find zero test files, and vitest may exit 1, turning verify and pre-push red spuriously. Add --passWithNoTests to both command builders.

findings.summary: coverageCommand puts changed-file paths into a command string run through sh -c without quoting; a path with spaces or shell metacharacters would be split or interpreted.
